class.name: NNHTNSearchSettings
class.brief_description: Resource configuring an [NNHTNRoot]'s search policy, planning budgets, and trace limits.
class.description: Assign to [member NNHTNRoot.search_settings] to choose how the planner selects plans ([member policy]), cap search work with [member max_expansions], [member max_time_ms], and [member max_binding_candidates], or adjust history retention when [member NNHTNRoot.track_search] is enabled.

method.name: get_validation_errors
method.description: Returns error messages for any invalid settings, or an empty array if valid.

members.member: Maximum candidates considered per [NNHTNBinding] or [method NNHTNMethod.on_resolve_arguments] call (minimum [code]1[/code]).
Maximum planning expansions allowed per search before stopping with [constant NNHTNRoot.BUDGET_EXHAUSTED] (minimum [code]1[/code]).
Maximum search traces retained when [member NNHTNRoot.track_search] is enabled (minimum [code]1[/code]).
Maximum total byte size of retained search traces when [member NNHTNRoot.track_search] is enabled (minimum [code]1024[/code]).
Maximum wall-clock milliseconds allowed per search. Set to [code]0[/code] for no time limit.
Maximum decision events recorded per traced search attempt (minimum [code]1[/code]).
Plan selection strategy ([constant ORDERED], [constant RANKED], or [constant LOWEST_COST]).

constants.constant: Tries methods in scene order and returns the first valid plan. Ignores method priority and task cost.
Tries methods from highest to lowest [member NNHTNMethod.priority] and returns the first valid plan. Ignores task cost.
Orders methods by priority and searches for the valid plan with the lowest total [member NNHTNTask.estimated_cost]. If a budget runs out, returns the cheapest plan found so far.
